item.description: By the seventh week, the world had learned to live between pulses.

item.description: Eight days had passed since the first unexplained pulse, and Delhi had stopped expecting an immediate explanation.

item.title: Chapter 1: Adya
item.description: At nine seventeen on Monday morning, Samyukt had thirty-eight thousand, four hundred and twelve rupees in the business account and three people asking him for money.
